name: What Lies Beyond
source:
A primordial beast named Aimo roams the sewers where the last remnants of humanity survives. Every 10 years there is a new Savior who ventures into the system to fix the faltering electricity in the city.

And this decade, that new Savior is... Jeanie.

[From [url=https://floatingturtles.itch.io/what-lies-beyond]Itch.io[/url]]
